column5: the helper itself: a Clone of http.DefaultTransport with Proxy set to nil (net/http default settings when a dependency replaced it); every production client takes its transport from here (or from externalurl.GuardedTransport, built on it); the second use names the replacement type in the fallback WARN line

the vendored module's own no-proxy transport (a separate module cannot import internal/httpguard): a Clone of http.DefaultTransport with Proxy set to nil (patch 0009, PROVENANCE.md); the second use names the replacement type in the fallback WARN line
dho push (customer machine, deliberate environment proxy as newIngestClientWithReadTimeout): asks ProxyFromEnvironment only to shape the request URL for a proxy, it sets no transport

dho push runs on the customer's machine and sends to the hosted ingest URL the customer configured; it sets http.ProxyFromEnvironment on its httpguard.Transport() on purpose, as the Python httpx client it ports honoured HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY/NO_PROXY (trust_env, Go port refusal parity); redirects are refused (CheckRedirect returns http.ErrUseLastResponse)

the transport is the package variable noProxyTransport, set once at package init by a function that returns a non-nil *http.Transport on every path (patch 0009); the guard does not prove package variables

the transport is the recorder itself (the method receiver, a *recorder the tool always builds before calling client); its RoundTrip falls back to httpguard.SharedTransport when it has no inner transport

the idempotency wrapper sits over client.Transport of the httpguard.NoRedirects copy, which NoRedirects gives httpguard.SharedTransport() when the supplied client has none; a nil fallback to SharedTransport() follows as well

the redirect witness sits over egressguard.Wrap(httpClient.Transport) of the httpguard.NoRedirects copy: Wrap gives a nil transport the guarded httpguard.SharedTransport() and an *http.Transport its guarded clone (no proxy), so the witness base is never nil; the witness also falls back to SharedTransport() on nil
the transport is the parameter; its only production caller passes externalurl.GuardedTransport(), and a nil one is replaced by externalurl.GuardedTransport() first

the transport is CompletePagesOnly over egressguard.Wrap(base): Wrap gives a nil base the guarded httpguard.SharedTransport() and an *http.Transport its guarded clone (no proxy); production passes nil (GatewayHTTPClient, and the worker's Atlassian Teams collector, whose gateway transport sync_dispatch.go sets to nil), the fixture world producer a recorded-answer transport

the transport is the parameter; a nil one is replaced by externalurl.GuardedTransport() first; production passes nil (newProviderFromCredentialsWithTransport: nil is the SSRF-guarded transport), only tests pass their own
the copy is given SharedTransport() when the supplied client has none (TestNoRedirectsGivesASuppliedClientWithoutATransportNoEnvironmentProxy)

the copy is given egressguard.Wrap(its Transport): a nil one becomes the guarded httpguard.SharedTransport(), an *http.Transport its guarded clone with no proxy (TestASuppliedClientWithoutATransportNeverDialsTheEnvironmentProxy, TestStoredProviderURLThatIsNotPublicIsRefusedForEveryFamily)

the Transport is egressguard.Wrap(the supplied client's Transport), never nil: Wrap gives a nil transport the guarded httpguard.SharedTransport(), an *http.Transport its guarded clone (Proxy nil), a TransportWrapper its guarded inner transport; any other RoundTripper is a test double (production clients take their transport from the approved constructors)
the copy is given egressguard.Wrap(its Transport), so a supplied client with none gets the guarded httpguard.SharedTransport() (TestEgressGuardedDoerShapes)

the Transport is egressguard.Wrap(the supplied client's Transport), never nil for a nil or *http.Transport input (guarded, Proxy nil); callers are the credential-sending constructors (NewGitHubAppAuth, NewPagerDutyClientCredentialsAuth) and atlassianteams.fetchTenantCloudID, each over an admitted doer

cigate docs host-smoke (the post-deploy docs host smoke in docs-cloudflare.yml) sets a Proxy func on its httpguard.Transport() on purpose: hsProxyFor reads HTTPS_PROXY/https_proxy/NO_PROXY/no_proxy with urllib.request rules (lower case wins), as the Python urllib script it ports honoured them (Go port refusal parity, CHAOS-10434); https URLs are tunnelled by hsDialTLS with its own CONNECT; TestHostSmokeHonoursHTTPSProxyAndNoProxy, TestHostSmokeProxyEnvironmentPrecedenceIsPythons, TestHostSmokeSendsProxyAuthorizationFromTheProxyURL
